frameData.name: Chomolungma
frameData.description:
While the public perception of GMS may be that of a stolid, conservative manufacturer, Union devotes substantial resources to the research and development of new armaments and technological breakthroughs in order to maintain or exceed parity with galactic-tier actors such as Harrison Armory or the Karrakin Trade Baronies. Under development by Union's Advanced Projects Special Research Agency in conjunction with General Massive Systems, the Chomolungma is a newer and more technologically advanced frame using the standard GMS Pattern I design as a base.

The Chomolungma is a specialist chassis, trading out weapon hardpoint mounting capability for additional sensors, comms/transmission arrays, and advanced GMS e-war systems including cutting-edge systemic intrusion software packages and recursive-weave hyperprocessors. In light of recent conflicts, Union has begun increasing distribution of Chomolungma licenses among both regular and auxiliary units to keep pace with evolutionary developments in battlefield tactics and technologies.

traits.name: Brilliance
traits.description: 1/scene, the Chomolungma may take any Quick Tech action as a free action, and then may either Bolster or Lock On as a free action.

active_effects.name: Brilliance
active_effects.detail: Take any Quick Tech action as a free action, and then may either Bolster or Lock On as a free action.

traits.name: Data Siphon
traits.description: Whenever the Chomolungma makes a tech attack against a hostile character, it may also automatically Scan them.

active_effects.name: Data Siphon
active_effects.detail: Whenever you make a tech attack against a hostile character, you may also automatically Scan them.
active_effects.condition: Make a tech attack against a hostile character.

traits.name: Replaceable Parts
traits.description: While resting, the Chomolungma can be repaired at a rate of 1 Repair per 1 structure damage, instead of 2 Repairs.

core_system.name: Advanced Intrusion Package
core_system.active_effect: Choose any number of hostile characters within Sensors and make a special Invade tech attack against them, ignoring Invisible and line of sight. On hit, apply the effects of Invade as normal, choosing options for each target. On miss, targets become Impaired until the end of their next turn.

active_actions.name: Wide-Area Code Pulse
active_actions.detail: Choose any number of hostile characters within Sensors and make a special Invade tech attack against them, ignoring Invisible and line of sight. On hit, apply the effects of Invade as normal, choosing options for each target. On miss, targets become Impaired until the end of their next turn.

core_system.passive_effect: Gain the following options for Invade:

passive_actions.name: Balance Control Lockout
passive_actions.detail: Push your target 2 spaces in any direction and knock them Prone. If they are already Prone, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn. You may only Immobilize each character this way 1/scene.

passive_actions.name: System Crusher
passive_actions.detail: Your target takes an additional 2 heat, for a total of 4 heat. If this Invade causes them to exceed their Heat Cap, they take 4 burn as well. This can only be used 1/scene on each character.

data.name: Type-3 Projected Shield

actions.name: Project Shield
actions.detail: Nominate a character within line of sight: all ranged or melee attacks that they make against you or that you make against them gain +2 Difficulty until the start of your next turn.

data.description: The GMS Type-3 Projected Shield traps and denies incoming projectiles by projecting an aggressive, superpositional anti-ballistic barrier.

data.name: Personalizations
data.effect:
You gain +2 HP and, in consultation with the GM, you may establish a minor modification you have made to your mech.
This mod has no numerical benefit beyond the additional HP it grants, but could provide other useful effects. If the GM agrees that this mod would help with either a pilot or mech skill check, you gain +1 Accuracy for that check.

active_effects.name: Personalizations
active_effects.detail: Your customizations relevant to a pilot or mech skill check, gains +1 Accuracy (GM discretion).

data.name: Type-I Flight System
data.effect: You may choose to count any and all of your movement as flying; however, you take Size +1 Heat at the end of any of your turns in which you fly this way.

active_effects.name: Type-I Flight System
active_effects.detail: You may choose to count any and all of your movement as flying; however, you take Size +1 Heat at the end of any of your turns in which you fly this way.

data.name: Custom Paint Job
data.effect:
When you take structure damage, roll 1d6. On a 6, you return to 1 HP and ignore the damage – the hit simply ‘scratched your paint’.
This system can only be used once before each Full Repair, and is not a valid target for system destruction.

active_effects.name: Custom Paint Job
active_effects.detail: When you take structure damage, roll 1d6. On a 6, you return to 1 HP and ignore the damage – the hit simply ‘scratched your paint’. This system can only be used once before each Full Repair.

data.name: Manipulators
data.effect: Your mech has an extra set of limbs. They are too small to have any combat benefit, but allow the mech to interact with objects that would otherwise be too small or sensitive (e.g., pilot-sized touch pads).

active_effects.name: Manipulators
active_effects.detail: Your mech has an extra set of limbs. They are too small to have any combat benefit, but allow the mech to interact with objects that would otherwise be too small or sensitive (e.g., pilot-sized touch pads).

data.description: Precise interaction with built and natural environments, soft targets, and hazardous materials is part of the daily routine for support-class mechs. This is made possible by manipulators – added multi-digit “hands” with haptic sensors.

data.name: Shotgun
data.description:
Much like GMS mechs, GMS weapons are reliable galactic standards, made using interchangeable parts and built to withstand almost any conditions. There are three lines currently in production.
The Type-I (T-1) line is defined by powerful, reliable, and conventional-kinetic ranged and melee weapons, including the GMS assault rifle, heavy machine gun, shotgun, pistol, and various light and heavy blades. Reliable galactic standards, the GMS T-1 line is the most widely used mech-scale line of weaponry across the galaxy. Echoing the Everest’s design notes, T-1 weapons are simply designed, with few (if any) moving parts, intended to be used in or adaptable to any environment.

data.name: Rocket-Propelled Grenade
data.description:
Much like GMS mechs, GMS weapons are reliable galactic standards, made using interchangeable parts and built to withstand almost any conditions. There are three lines currently in production.
The Type-III (T-3) line is made up of heavy weapons, ordnance, and other exotic, specialized, or massive weapons. A broad classification, the T-3 range includes conventional-kinetic anti-materiel rifles, super-rapid cycling pulse rifles, missile racks, cannons, and drone nexuses – “hive”style launchers that serve as miniature factory, hangar, and deployment systems for portable drones. The classification also includes the fearsome “segment knife”, a system that uses flash-printing to produce disposable edged weapons in a vicinity around the user.

data.name: Act Unseen or Unheard
data.description: Get somewhere or do something without detection.
data.detail: Get somewhere or do something without being detected, but not necessarily with speed. Hide, sneak, or move quietly. Infiltrate a facility while avoiding security, patrols, or cameras. Perform a quick action or maneuver without being seen or heard, such as picking a pocket, unholstering your gun, or cheating at cards. Wear a disguise.

data.name: Spot
data.description: Spot details, objects, or people that are hidden or difficult to make out.
data.detail: Spot hidden or difficult to make out details, objects, or people. Spot ambushes, hidden compartments, or disguised individuals. Spy on a target from a distance, or make out the details, shape, and number of objects, vehicles, mechs, or people clearly at a distance. Track people or vehicles.

data.name: Stay Cool
data.description: Perform a task that requires concentration, dexterity, speed, or precision under pressure.
data.detail: Do something that requires concentration, speed, or intense precision under pressure, like picking a lock as your squad trades fire with encroaching guards, avoiding a hostile memetic code while hacking a secure console, carefully disarming an explosive, or unjamming a gun under fire. If you’ve got to do something complicated in a high stress situation without messing up (and possibly not even breaking a sweat) this is the action to use.

data.name: Take Someone Out
data.description: Kill or disable someone quickly and quietly.
data.detail: Kill or disable someone quickly and quietly, from up close and personal or from a distance, probably before they even notice. This is probably a single person but could be two people relatively close together (any more is sort of stretching it and definitely risky). If you’re looking down a sniper scope at a target, preparing to nerve pinch a guard to knock them out instantly, quick-drawing during a gun duel, or dropping from a ceiling to slit a throat, this is the action to use.

data.name: Infiltrator
data.terse: Improve your Hide action and perform debilitating sneak attacks
data.description: Whether by spoofing signatures on enemy scanners, moving skillfully through cover, or thanks to your modded optical camouflage, you’re never seen unless you want to be. Whatever the size of the mech, whatever the terrain, whatever the enemy, you can get in and get out without raising alarm.

ranks.name: Prowl
ranks.description:
During your turn, gain the following benefits:
  • Entering line of sight of hostile characters or moving from cover does not stop you from being Hidden.
  • You can pass freely through – but not end your turn in – enemy spaces.
  • You can Hide even in plain sight of enemies.
    These effects immediately end when your turn ends (so you lose Hidden if you’re still in line of sight or out of cover at that time).

active_effects.detail:

ranks.name: Ambush
ranks.description: When you start your turn Hidden, the first attack roll of any type that you make sends your target reeling on a hit. Your target must succeed on a Hull save or become Slowed, Impaired, and unable to take reactions until the end of their next turn.

active_effects.name: Ambush

active_effects.condition: You start your turn Hidden and make an attack roll

ranks.name: Mastermind
ranks.description:
When you lose Hidden (by any means), you may first fire a flash bomb at any adjacent character. That character must pass a Systems save or only be able to draw line of sight to adjacent spaces until the end of their next turn.
You can then move up to your speed, ignoring engagement and not provoking reactions, and are then revealed normally.

data.name: Vanguard
data.terse: Improve your CQB weapons and make Overwatching more effective
data.description: Where would you rather be: in the battle line, shoulder-to-shoulder with the rest of the cannon fodder, or in the rush, at the head of the attack, your livery clean and bright, with glory to be won? The answer is easy. All those missiles and lances, all those hundred-kilometer, adjust-for-Coriolis railguns – they’re all useless against you. Get through their guard, get in their face, and make them know your name.

ranks.name: Handshake Etiquette
ranks.description: Gain +1 Accuracy when using CQB weapons to attack targets within Range 3.

ranks.name: See-Through Seeker
ranks.description: You’ve modified your sensors and ammo to punch through, disregard, or otherwise ignore cover at close range. As long as you have line of sight, you ignore both soft and hard cover when using CQB weapons to attack targets within Range 3.

data.name: Hunter
data.terse: Gain mobility and range when using Auxiliary Melee weapons
data.description: The battlefield is Edith Eidelen’s hunting ground, her domain. It’s only through a true test of strength and guile that will determine who is the predator and who is the prey. Her movement across the field is a prowl: silent, quick, and controlled. In a chassis, she excels in close combat, closing the gap between her and her targets before they can bring their guns to bear.

ranks.name: Lunge
ranks.description: 1/round, when you attack with an Auxiliary melee weapon, you may fly up to 3 spaces directly towards the targeted character before the attack. This movement ignores engagement and doesn’t provoke reactions.

active_effects.name: Lunge

ranks.name: Knife Juggler
ranks.description: All your Auxiliary melee weapons gain Thrown 5, if they don’t have this property already – if they already have Thrown, it increases to Thrown 5. At the end of your turn, all weapons you have thrown this turn automatically return to you.

synergies.detail: This weapon gains Thrown 5 and will return to you at the end of your turn if thrown.

ranks.description: 1/round, when you hit a character with a melee attack, you may also throw an Auxiliary melee weapon as an attack against any character within Range as a free action. This attack can’t deal bonus damage.

data.name: Stealth Hardsuit
data.effect: As a quick action, pilots wearing stealth hardsuits can become Invisible. They cease to be Invisible if they take any damage.

actions.name: Activate Stealth Hardsuit
actions.detail: Become Invisible. You will cease to be Invisible if you take any damage.

data.name: Light Signature
data.description: Light signature weapons might be oversized revolvers, braces of pistols, and submachine guns.
data.effect: When a signature weapon is acquired, choose its damage type – Explosive, Energy, or Kinetic.

weapons.flavorDescription: Standard issue duty sidearm with carved grip to match the handle of the survival knife

data.name: Light A/C
data.description: Light A/C weapons might be knives, bayonets, punching daggers, and short swords.

data.name: Flexsuit
data.description: A strong base-layer suit that recycles water, generates nutrients, and adapts very rapidly to hostile environs, maintaining a stable condition and extending survivability. Flexsuit wearers can go for roughly a week without eating or drink thanks to the ambrosia paste generated by their suit before its systems are depleted; however, they don’t prevent feelings of hunger. Removing the suit for a day or two is enough to replenish its reserves. Flexsuits also maintain a steady temperature within acceptable parameters.

data.name: Smart Scope
data.description: A powerful electronic scope that provides high-resolution magnification up to two miles, and automatically adjusts its reticle for wind, gravity, and pressure. Smart scopes can project their field of vision and all data to the HUD of any networked user. They can also pair with other thermal, optical, or simulated-vision devices to further enhance targeting.

data.name: Wilderness Survival Kit
data.description: This kit contains many essentials for surviving in hostile environments: a rebreather, water filters, hardsuit patches, backup thermals, a bivouac kit, and so on.
